comments.text:
Oh look, another ‘MAGA states are collapsing’ headline designed to make coastal Twitter feel smart for 12 minutes 😂

Farmers have been getting squeezed for years by debt, inflation, corporate consolidation, fuel costs, droughts, and global markets,  but suddenly every media outlet acts like rural America only exists when they can blame Trump for it.

Also funny how the same people mocking ‘flyover states’ panic every election cycle trying to figure out why those voters still don’t trust them
